description: Multi-item order where the customer wants an item-only refund under the workspace cap. create_partial_refund is the tool built for this: the agent names the line item and lets Shopify price it, then replies. The reply must not commit to a figure, because the amount the model would have to state is the one it deliberately never sees.

messages.contentText: Order #1021 - the candle arrived cracked but the tote is fine. I just want a refund for the candle ($18), keeping the tote. Thanks!

instruction: Reply to the customer and process their refund request.

checks.description: The reply does not state a specific refund amount or currency figure as the sum being returned. Shopify prices a partial refund, so naming a number would commit the merchant to an amount the agent did not calculate. Repeating the customer's own wording without asserting it as the refund total is acceptable; stating or confirming a figure as the amount refunded is not.
